list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A chloride-bridged dimer with two pentacoordinate scandium centers; each center bears silylamido ligands and tetrahydrofuran. The article reports an agostic Si–H interaction at each scandium center.

synthesis.procedure: The two-equivalent salt-metathesis reaction of a scandium chloride tetrahydrofuran precursor with lithium bis(dimethylsilyl)amide gave a mixture containing 2a and the tris-amido compound 1a. Single crystals of 2a were obtained by fractional crystallization.
synthesis.yield: Complexes 2 were reported at approximately 50–70% in the initial mixtures; no isolated yield specific to 2a was given.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A dimer with two bridging chlorides and pentacoordinate yttrium centers bearing silylamido and tetrahydrofuran ligands. The article describes two agostic Si–H interactions at each yttrium center.

synthesis.procedure: In a glovebox, lithium bis(dimethylsilyl)amide was added to a suspension of yttrium chloride tetrahydrofuran precursor in hexane. After 24 h of stirring, the mixture was centrifuged and filtered, solvent was removed under vacuum, and the residue was recrystallized from hexane. Crystals contained 2b and 1b in a 1:0.27 ratio.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifugation, filtration, solvent removal under vacuum, and recrystallization from hexane.
synthesis.yield: 73% in the crude mixture by 1H NMR (0.365 g, 0.40 mmol); crystals also contained 1b.

material_class.structural_family: Chloride- and amide-bridged trinuclear silylamido cluster

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Three distorted-octahedral Nd centers form a discrete cluster linked by two μ2- and two μ3-chlorides and a bridging silylamido ligand. Nd2 and Nd3 each carry a terminal amido ligand and tetrahydrofuran; Nd1 carries two terminal amido ligands. The silylamido ligands exhibit agostic distortions.

synthesis.procedure: Salt metathesis of the neodymium chloride tetrahydrofuran precursor with 1.9–2.1 equivalents of lithium bis(dimethylsilyl)amide reproducibly afforded 4d. Crystals were obtained from hexane.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: An ionic salt comprising a [YCl2(thf)5]+ cation and a [YCl4(thf)2]− anion, identified from crystals formed after dissolution of 5b in tetrahydrofuran. The article cites prior crystallographic literature for this identity.

synthesis.procedure: A solution of mixed methyl/chloride material 5b in tetrahydrofuran immediately formed a white precipitate; crystals of the yttrium chloride tetrahydrofuran salt were harvested after several days.
synthesis.time: Several days before crystals were harvested
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: White precipitate formed immediately; crystals harvested after several days.
